items.title: Monster House
items.description: No adults believe three youths' (Mitchel Musso, Spencer Locke, Sam Lerner) assertion that a neighboring residence is a living creature that means them harm.

items.title: The Secret Life of Pets
items.description: A domesticated terrier (Louis C.K.) and his unruly canine pal (Eric Stonestreet) encounter a rebellious bunny (Kevin Hart) and his gang of abandoned pets.

items.title: Matilda
items.description: A little girl develops extraordinary mental abilities, despite neglectful parents and a brutal headmistress.

items.title: The Mask
items.description: Bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss is transformed into a manic superhero when he wears a mysterious mask.

items.title: Scooby-Doo
items.description: Fred (Freddie Prinze Jr.), Daphne (Sarah Michelle Gellar), Velma, Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and Scooby investigate claims that a theme park is haunted.

items.title: Second Chance Holiday
items.description: Chelsey is determined to break her curse of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame, she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe's way of leading her back to her first love.

items.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
items.description: Explore the emotional lives of pets and the deep bond between them and the families that love them as Max, Gidget, Snowball and the rest of the gang take on new adventures and push themselves to find the courage to become their own heroes.

items.title: The Holiday Spark
items.description: When illustrator Laura arrives at her parents' smoke-filled home to find a charming firefighter already on the scene, an unexpected spark ignites.

items.title: The Town
items.description: A Boston bank robber (Ben Affleck) looks for a way out of his criminal lifestyle after beginning a passionate romance with the woman (Rebecca Hall) that his gang briefly took hostage.

items.title: Sing
items.description: A pig (Reese Witherspoon), a mouse (Seth MacFarlane), a porcupine (Scarlett Johansson), a gorilla (Taron Egerton), an elephant (Tori Kelly) and other animals gather at a koala's (Matthew McConaughey) theater for a singing competition.

items.title: Monsters vs. Aliens
items.description: A giant woman (Reese Witherspoon), a bug-headed scientist (Hugh Laurie) and a gelatinous mass (Seth Rogen) are among the ragtag monsters that must defend Earth from a rampaging alien robot.

items.title: Free Willy
items.description: An abandoned boy (Jason James Richter) with a chip on his shoulder befriends an ill-fated killer whale at a water park.

items.title: A Dog's Way Home
items.description: As a puppy, Bella finds her way into the arms of Lucas, a young man who gives her a good home. When Bella becomes separated from Lucas, she soon finds herself on an epic, 400-mile journey to reunite with her beloved owner.

items.title: Orphan
items.description: A series of alarming events leads a woman to believe that something evil lurks behind the angelic face of her recently adopted daughter.

items.title: Wanted
items.description: After his estranged father is murdered, an office drone (James McAvoy) joins secret assassins who take their orders from Fate itself.

items.title: The Last Samurai
items.description: In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

items.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
items.description: Estranged from his wife (Sally Field), an out-of-work actor (Robin Williams) masquerades as a nanny to be with his children.

items.title: Mamma Mia!
items.description: Hoping to meet her real father and have him walk her down the aisle, a bride secretly invites three men from her mother's (Meryl Streep) past to come to the wedding.

items.title: Never Let Go
items.description: When an unspeakable evil takes over the world, the only protection for a mother and her twin sons is their house and strong bond. Needing to stay connected at all times, they tether themselves with ropes, clinging to one another and never letting go.

items.title: Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed
items.description: Fred, Daphne, Velma, Shaggy and Scooby investigate a group of ghouls terrorizing people.

items.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
items.description: A husband and wife are unaware that each is an international assassin who has just been assigned to kill the other.

items.title: Once Upon a Time... In Hollywood
items.description: Actor Rick Dalton and his longtime stunt double struggle to find work in a Hollywood they don't recognize anymore. Rick also happens to live next door to Roman Polanski and Sharon Tate -- a couple whose futures will be altered by the Manson Family.

items.title: The Call of the Wild
items.description: Buck is a big-hearted dog whose blissful domestic life gets turned upside down when he is suddenly uprooted from his California home and transplanted to the exotic wilds of the Alaskan Yukon in the 1890s.

items.title: The Cobbler
items.description: A frustrated shoemaker (Adam Sandler) finds a magical sewing machine that allows him to see the world in a new way by stepping into the lives of his customers.

items.title: Grumpy Cat's Worst Christmas Ever
items.description: A curmudgeonly kitty helps a little girl find the spirit and charm of Christmas, in a holiday adventure.

items.title: We Bought a Zoo
items.description: A widower (Matt Damon) relocates his family to a dilapidated zoo and, with the help of its eclectic staff, works to restore the facility to its former glory.

items.title: Father of the Bride
items.description: A harried patriarch (Steve Martin) faces separation anxiety, exorbitant costs and more as he prepares for his daughter's (Kimberly Williams) wedding.

items.title: A Christmas Wish
items.description: Every December in the small town of Ponchatoula, La., a wooden wishing box is placed in the park as a Christmas tradition. People write down their true heart's desire on a slip of paper and place it in the box.

items.title: A Christmas in Tennessee
items.description: A baker unites the people of her small mountain town to resist a real estate developer's plan to build a ski resort.

items.title: Moulin Rouge!
items.description: In the 1890s France a courtesan falls in love with a young writer but strings along a duke who can finance improvements to the night spot.

items.title: Message in a Bottle
items.description: Kevin Costner as Garret and Robin Wright Penn as Theresa bring high-voltage star power to Message in a Bottle, a tale of love lost and found based on Nicholas Sparks' bestseller.

items.title: Dances With Wolves
items.description: Costner's epic vision of the American frontier as seen through the eyes of a 19th-century U.S. Cavalry officer.

items.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
items.description: An anthropologist (Rick Schroder) leads an expedition to an underground world of prehistoric beasts and primitive man.

items.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
items.description: In 1979 Donna falls in love with Sam while embarking on a series of adventures throughout Europe. In the present day, Donna's pregnant daughter reunites with her mother's old friends and boyfriends on the Greek island of Kalokairi.

items.title: On Golden Pond
items.description: An old professor (Henry Fonda) and his wife (Katharine Hepburn) make peace with their daughter (Jane Fonda) in New England.

items.title: The Hitman's Bodyguard
items.description: The world's top protection agent gets a new client: a hitman who came in from the cold. After being on the opposite ends of a bullet for years, they must team up and have only 24 hours to get to The Hague to bring down a murderous dictator.

items.title: A Very Vintage Christmas
items.description: An antique shop owner finds a hidden box containing an eclectic collection of mementos. She decides to make it her mission to deliver it to its rightful owner.

items.title: Once Upon a Main Street
items.description: A man and a woman take over the responsibilities for an annual holiday competition.

items.title: Hitman's Wife's Bodyguard
items.description: The bodyguard, Michael Bryce, continues his friendship with assassin, Darius Kincaid, as they try to save Darius' wife Sonia.

items.title: Christmas Lodge
items.description: Mary decides to restore the dilapidated lodge where she spent the holidays with her family growing up.

items.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
items.description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

items.title: A Christmas Village
items.description: Piper agrees to work for the owner of the failing Santa's Village.

items.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
items.description: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse.

items.title: Unlikely Angel
items.description: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays.

items.title: A Christmas Wish
items.description: The owner (Tess Harper) of a diner helps a homeless woman (Kristy Swanson) and her children during the holidays.

items.title: Priscilla
items.description: When teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who is already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, a vulnerable best friend.

items.title: Labyrinth
items.description: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

items.title: Bigfoot Family
items.description: Bigfoot disappears without a trace while protecting a wildlife reserve, prompting Adam, his mom and their animal friends to head to Alaska to rescue him.

items.title: Where the Red Fern Grows
items.description: A young Ozarks boy listens to his grandfather and saves up to buy two raccoon hounds in the 1930s Oklahoma.

items.title: 100% Wolf
items.description: Freddy Lupin can't wait to become a werewolf, just like his legendary father. But when the big day arrives, something goes awry as Freddy transforms into a ferocious poodle.

items.title: Call Me Claus
items.description: Facing mandatory retirement after 200 years, Santa Claus (Nigel Hawthorne) asks a television producer (Whoopi Goldberg) to replace him.

items.title: Monster Family 2: Nobody's Perfect
items.description: Members of the Wishbone family transform into a vampire, a mummy, a werewolf and Frankenstein to save their monster friends from a mysterious hunter.

items.title: I Saw Mommy Kissing Santa Claus
items.description: A boy behaves badly after thinking Santa is trying to ruin his parents' (Connie Sellecca, Corbin Bernsen) marriage.

items.title: Alpha and Omega
items.description: After park rangers relocate them halfway across the country, a carefree wolf (Justin Long) and his stern companion (Hayden Panettiere) must find a way back to their pack to prevent a war.

items.title: The Master of Disguise
items.description: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

items.title: Ozzy
items.description: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners.

items.title: The New Adventures of Pippi Longstocking
items.description: Reckless Pippi makes friends, walks on walls, spins fast and thwarts a wicked schoolmarm.

items.title: Rock Dog 2: Rock Around the Park
items.description: Canine rocker Bodi and his band discover the price of fame when they go on tour with pop sensation Lil' Foxy.

items.title: My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games
items.description: Canterlot High and Crystal Prep Academy compete in a series of exciting events, including archery, motocross and roller skating.

items.title: The Care Bears
items.description: An evil spirit attempts to undermine the Care Bears' mission to spread goodwill to children around the world.

items.title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
items.description: Emmet Otter and his mother, Ma Otter, are dirt-poor, and they want to get a special present for each other by winning the talent show against the Riverbottom Gang, a group of rich kids with electric instruments.

items.title: The Family Stone
items.description: Everett brings Meredith to meet his bohemian family at Christmas. While trying to win the approval of her boyfriend's parents and the rest of his family, she only succeeds in highlighting her uptight personality, making Everett doubt his intentions.

items.title: A Christmas Carol
items.description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (George C. Scott) meets the ghosts of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

items.title: Transporter 3
items.description: Mob courier Frank Martin and the subject of his assignment, a cynical Ukrainian woman, are fitted with shackles that will explode if they wander too far from his car.

items.title: The Front Room
items.description: Everything goes to hell for newly pregnant Belinda after her mother-in-law moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere.

items.title: We Live in Time
items.description: A surprise encounter brings together a couple, changing the course of their lives. Challenged by the limits of time, they learn to cherish each moment of their decade-spanning and movingly rare love story.

items.title: Good Time
items.description: A bank robber stops at nothing to free his brother from prison, launching himself into a nightlong odyssey through New York's dark and dangerous criminal underworld.

items.title: Beau Is Afraid
items.description: A paranoid man embarks on a darkly funny and nightmarish odyssey to get home to his mother.

items.title: Dirty Grandpa
items.description: One week before his wedding, an uptight lawyer finds himself driving his foulmouthed grandfather to Daytona Beach, Fla., for a wild spring break that includes frat parties, bar fights and a karaoke night.

items.title: Cell
items.description: A graphic novelist (John Cusack) begins a desperate search for his estranged wife (Clark Sarullo) and son (Ethan Andrew Casto) after a mysterious cellphone signal transforms New Englanders into savage killers.

items.title: Hereditary
items.description: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

items.title: Fly Away Home
items.description: A Canadian sculptor (Jeff Daniels) builds an ultralight plane so his teen daughter (Anna Paquin) can lead geese south.

items.title: Father of the Bride Part II
items.description: A worrisome family patriarch (Steve Martin) is driven to further distraction by the simultaneous pregnancies of his wife (Diane Keaton) and daughter.

items.title: Killing Them Softly
items.description: After a rival crook hires a pair of bumbling thieves (Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn) to rob their card game, mobsters hire a reluctant hit man (Brad Pitt) to settle the score.

items.title: Driving Miss Daisy
items.description: Over 25 years, as the American South changes profoundly, the friendship between a highly independent, eccentric Jewish matron and the stalwart and very patient black widower.

items.title: Dangerous
items.description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

items.title: Hercules (2014)
items.description: Hercules helps defend Thrace from a powerful warlord.

items.title: Fargo
items.description: A pregnant police chief (Frances McDormand) probes the murderous events that evolved from a desperate car salesman's (William H. Macy) kidnapping scheme.

items.title: A Christmas Karen
items.description: Karen is an entitled middle-aged woman whose demanding nature has alienated her neighbors and family. After a series of incidents displaying her privilege and prejudice, Karen receives an 'intervention' by some unconventional spirits.

items.title: ATL
items.description: Four Atlanta teenagers, whose lives revolve around hip-hop and rollerskating, face life-changing challenges on and off the rink.

items.title: Backcountry
items.description: A couple (Missy Peregrym, Jeff Roop) on a deep-wilderness hike become hopelessly lost within an aggressive black bear's territory.

items.title: Christmas With a View
items.description: A ski resort is abuzz when a celebrity chef is named the new head chef. Clara isn't excited about her new boss, but with their paths constantly crossing, Clara realizes that they have more in common than they realized.

items.title: Lady Bird
items.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school.

items.title: Chasing Secrets
items.description: A black couple (Della Reese, Ossie Davis) provide sanctuary for an abused white girl in the pre-civil rights South.

items.title: The Giver
items.description: A teen (Brenton Thwaites) discovers the dark truth about his community's secret past from an old man (Jeff Bridges) who is the sole keeper of their world's memories.

items.title: Child's Play
items.description: A struggling single mother unknowingly gifts her son a doll imbued with a serial killer's consciousness.

items.title: Osmosis Jones
items.description: When a white blood cell cop and a virus clash, zoo worker Frank's life hangs in the balance.

items.title: Slow West
items.description: A bounty hunter keeps his true motive a secret from the naive Scottish teenager he's offered to serve as bodyguard and guide while the youth searches for his beloved in the 1800s Colorado.

items.title: Christmas Time
items.description: Kevin Snowdon is a London-based physics teacher who leans on science to support his obsessive dislike for Christmas. Hoping to cure him, his wife hatches a scheme that sends their family to the holiday-themed tourist destination of Lapland.

items.title: Christmas in the Pines
items.description: As an up-and-coming magazine writer and a successful architect battle over ownership of an idyllic Christmas cottage, they soon discover that their cozy holiday getaway may not be the only thing they love.

items.title: The Long Riders
items.description: The Jesse James-Cole Younger gang leaves a trail of emptied banks, plundered stagecoaches and dead bodies in its wake.

items.title: Borrowed Hearts: A Holiday Romance
items.description: Sam has to pretend that he has a family in order to close a deal. He manages to convince Kathleen to help him out by posing as his family, along with her daughter, Zoe.

items.title: Mrs. Santa Claus
items.description: Mrs. Claus feels unappreciated when Santa Claus refuses to look over her new route for distributing presents. She goes for a test drive on the sleigh, but lands in New York City due to horrid weather, injuring her reindeer.

items.title: The Farewell
items.description: Billi's family returns to China under the guise of a fake wedding to stealthily say goodbye to their beloved matriarch — the only person that doesn't know she only has a few weeks to live.

items.title: Blitz
items.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers.

items.title: Judy Moody and the NOT Bummer Summer
items.description: A feisty third-grader (Jordana Beatty) must think of new ways to have fun after her original plans for an awesome summer go awry.

items.title: Mr. Mom
items.description: A newly unemployed man keeps house while his wife works.

items.title: Wyatt Earp's Revenge
items.description: An aged Wyatt Earp (Val Kilmer) reflects on his career as a lawman.

items.title: Dredd
items.description: In a violent, futuristic metropolis, a law-enforcement officer (Karl Urban) and his rookie trainee (Olivia Thirlby) become caught up in a high-stakes conflict with a vicious prostitute-turned-drug lord (Lena Headey).

items.title: Cowgirls 'n Angels
items.description: A girl joins rodeo trick-riders and embarks on a tour with them in the hope that she will find her long-lost father along the way.
